arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_ids,
       SUM(debut = '' OR final_game = '') AS blank_pairs,
       SUM(debut IS NULL OR final_game IS NULL) AS null_pairs,
       SUM(date(debut) IS NOT NULL AND date(final_game) IS NOT NULL) AS parseable_pairs,
       MIN(NULLIF(debut, '')) AS first_debut, MAX(final_game) AS last_game
FROM main.player

arguments.sql:
WITH player_spans AS (
    SELECT
        ROUND(ABS(strftime('%Y', final_game) - strftime('%Y', debut)), 2)
        + ROUND(ABS(strftime('%m', final_game) - strftime('%m', debut)) / 12.0, 2)
        + ROUND(ABS(strftime('%d', final_game) - strftime('%d', debut)) / 365.0, 2)
        AS career_span_years
    FROM main.player
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span_years), 2) AS average_career_span_years
FROM player_spans
LIMIT 1
